title.en: State the conditions for total internal reflection
Relate critical angle to refractive index

say.en: Your internet arrives through a glass fibre thinner than a hair, and the light inside it does not leak out even when the cable bends. How? In this lesson: State the conditions for total internal reflection.
Relate critical angle to refractive index.
Explain optical fibres and prisms.

body.en: When light goes from a denser to a rarer medium, the refracted ray bends away from the normal. At the *critical angle* $C$ the refracted ray grazes the surface ($r = 90°$). For any larger angle no light is refracted; it is all reflected back. This is total internal reflection. For a medium of index $n$ against air, $\sin C = 1/n$.
body.kn: ಸಾಂದ್ರದಿಂದ ವಿರಳ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಆಪಾತ ಕೋನ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ ಕೋನಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಅದು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. sin C = 1/n.

title.en: Board: when light cannot get out

narration.en: Let us send rays from inside glass towards the surface at bigger and bigger angles.

say.en: A source S inside glass sends a ray at a small angle. It refracts out, bending away from the normal.
At the critical angle C the refracted ray grazes along the surface.
Beyond C no light escapes: all of it reflects back into the glass. This is total internal reflection.
At the critical angle the refraction angle is 90°, so sin C = 1/n. Glass: about 42°. Diamond: about 24°, which is why it sparkles.
An optical fibre traps light by repeated total internal reflection, because the core is denser than the cladding.
Let us send rays from inside glass towards the surface at bigger and bigger angles.

narration.en: Light going from a denser medium into air bends away from the normal: n sin i = sin r. As i grows, r reaches 90° at the critical angle, sin ic = 1/n. Beyond that no light gets out: all of it is reflected. This keeps light inside optical fibres and makes diamonds sparkle.
narration.kn: ಪೂರ್ಣ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲನ. ಸ್ಲೈಡರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಿ, ಓದುಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಗಮನಿಸಿ.

caption.kn: ಸಾಂದ್ರ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮದಿಂದ ಗಾಳಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಬೆಳಕು ಲಂಬದಿಂದ ದೂರ ಬಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: n sin i = sin r. i ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಂತೆ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ ಕೋನದಲ್ಲಿ r = 90°, sin ic = 1/n. ಅದರ ಆಚೆ ಬೆಳಕು ಹೊರಬರದು: ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ದ್ಯುತಿ ತಂತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಕನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ, ವಜ್ರ ಮಿನುಗುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Light going from a denser medium into air bends away from the normal: n sin i equals sin r. As i grows, r reaches 90 degrees at the critical angle, sin ic equals 1 over n. Beyond that no light gets out: all of it is reflected. This keeps light inside optical fibres and makes diamonds sparkle.

body.en: Diamond has a small critical angle (about 24°), so light entering it is reflected many times inside and it sparkles. Right-angled prisms turn light through 90° or 180° by *total internal reflection*. Optical fibres carry light by repeated total internal reflection at the boundary between the core and the cladding of lower refractive index. Mirages are another example.
body.kn: ವಜ್ರದ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ ಕೋನ ಚಿಕ್ಕದು, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅದು ಹೊಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಿಸಂಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ದೃಗ್ ನಾರುಗಳು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲನದಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the critical angle for diamond, n equals 2.42.
sin C equals 1 over n equals 1 over 2.42 is approximately 0.413.
C equals sin to the power minus 10.413 is approximately 24.4 degrees.
So the answer is is approximately 24.4 degrees.

problem.en: A lamp is 4 m below the surface of water (n = 4/3). Find the radius of the circle on the surface through which light comes out.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A lamp is 4 m below the surface of water (n = 4/3). Find the radius of the circle on the surface through which light comes out.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A lamp is 4 metres below the surface of water (n equals 4 over 3). Find the radius of the circle on the surface through which light comes out.
sin C equals 3 over 4, so tan C equals 3/ the square root of 7.
r equals h tan C equals 4 times 3/ the square root of 7.
r is approximately 4.54 metres.
So the answer is is approximately 4.5 metres.
